changes.cadence: Estimate source video frame rate from encoded access-unit PTS at the production renderer input; independent of display Hz, wall clock, decoder speed, dropped/rendered frames and video output type.
changes.hevc: Bounded 256 timestamp window; sort for B-frame decode order and deduplicate; lattice/regression accepts millisecond/90kHz rounding, rejects variable cadence/discontinuities and separates fractional/integer standards.
changes.lifecycle: Stream-scoped observer and generation guard discard old channel results; seek/actual format change reset the sampler; metadata-only HLS id/bitrate updates preserve cadence and measured UI value.
changes.nominal: Stable source PTS may override an incorrect nominal rate (test: declared60, actual25). The previous rendered-frame half-rate guard is removed from that path.
changes.sharedValue: Same source rate feeds the bottom panel, diagnostics and Android AFR. Existing labels/translations for frames/s and screen Hz retained.

regression.before: Two focused common tests fail on the previous estimator: rounded HEVC PTS and B-frame/decode-order PTS with duplicates. Captured log retained.
regression.common: AVC/HEVC-independent source timestamps at 23.976/24/25/29.97/30/50/59.94/60, discontinuities, duplicate PTS, variable cadence and reset.
regression.android: Real Media3 renderer init/enable/render/read/format/queue flow on API28/35. Controlled codec adapter accepts240 inputs and emits zero output, proving no dependence on display/render callbacks. HLS header updates every12 inputs, rounded PTS and B-order tested. Actual controller publishes23.976; wrong nominal60 corrected to25 in both StateFlow and diagnostics. Codec-data change and departing-channel pending results checked.
regression.retained: Existing native startup surface gate, protected codec reset/tuning, HLS audio discovery, native AC3/EAC3/DTS and Compose navigation/animation suites pass.

limitations: No physical TCL/Ugoos or direct provider stream measurement; tests use controlled source timestamps and codec adapter, without native video decode.
Cadence describes timestamped source frames, not a count of distinct images or actual frames seen on a TV. Nominal stream rate is used until a stable estimate is available.
Unknown or genuinely variable/broken timestamps are not replaced with the screen refresh rate.
